## Checklist Before Requesting Review
- [ ] I followed the team Git workflow (feature branch, no commits directly to main).
- [ ] My changes are strictly within my owned module/folder or discussed with the module owner.
- [ ] If shared files (routes/index.js, AppRoutes.jsx, Sidebar) were touched, only single-line integrations were added.
- [ ] API contracts in docs/api-contracts.md were updated/agreed before implementation.
- [ ] Database migrations follow the strict sequential numbering rule (no editing old migrations).
- [ ] Existing features and login flow continue to function without errors.
